toml:
# Fault/anomaly detection for quantum PNT systems — labelled fault catalog +
# ROC AUC + minimum-detectable fault, quantum-clock-aided vs classical monitor.

fault_mu = 1.0
quantum_sigma = 0.3
classical_sigma = 1.0
pfa = 1.0e-3
pd = 0.9
samples = 2000
seed = 42
